# snack.

> snack. (snack.com.au) builds small Australian businesses a website for $100
> to start and $75 a month from go-live — a deliberately bite-size,
> fixed-scope alternative to a $5,000 custom build. Sites are built in about a
> week. It is a product of the LINK group in Brisbane, run as its own brand.

Key facts (current as of July 2026):
- $100 + GST one-off to start the build. Non-refundable, and the site says
  why: it filters out tyre-kickers and covers the first pass of real work
- $75 + GST a month from the day the site goes live — hosting, security,
  updates and support included. No lock-in contract
- Optional add-ons at sign-up: logo design +$200, full brand kit +$250
- Secret Sauce, the optional SEO add-on, is $45 + GST a month
- Buy-out is $1,500 flat and the site is yours forever
- Change requests are lodged in the client dashboard and actioned within
  48 hours
- On ranking, the site states plainly that nobody can promise a number one
  position on Google; Secret Sauce does the consistent work search engines
  reward — fresh content, a fast healthy site, and tracking
- Payment runs through Stripe Checkout; card details are never entered on
  snack.com.au
- Every enquiry from the site lands in one dashboard alongside visitor
  numbers and site health

## Key pages
- [snack.](https://snack.com.au/): the whole offer, pricing, FAQs and the sign-up form
- [Terms](https://snack.com.au/terms.html): what is included, what is not, and the buy-out
